desc: a phone guest's app goes to the background for 20 s in a relay room, as Android holds it (TTYD_SYNC_BACKGROUND_AT: the others told it stepped away, the game's thread held, its connection kept): the host keeps its place, link and seat (no quiet drop while it's away), says '<name> stepped away.' and '<name> is back.'; back in front the guest connects again at once (away longer than the quiet time) and the session resumes, the same progress at the end, no end window

log_must: co-op: player 2 stepped away \(their app in the background\)
log_must_not: net: connection to a player lost \(quiet\)

log_must: test: the app to the background at frame 1500 for 20000 ms
net: back from the background after 20 s: the relay asked again at once
